service.description: The signed-in user's people: from their rooms (a direct room of two, a pair room of one outside number, a GroupMe direct conversation; the 200 newest in sight), their own merges, splits and names, and the app's contacts they can see (find#ContactPeople, asked only about the addresses of their rooms that they have not grouped themselves, its answer kept three minutes, at most 60 times an hour: then contactsSkipped; hookFailed when it failed). personList, each {personKey (p:id for a person the user changed, else a:its lowest address), name, nameFrom (mine, user, contact or empty), edited, reachable (false: a user the signed-in user may not reach, refused or blocking: no new chat), userId, contactUrl, addresses [{addressKey, kind (user, tel, email, ext), label}], rooms [{chatRoomId, network (moqui, sms, rcs, groupme), encrypted, fromNumber, lastMessageDate, lastInboundDate, notConnected}], ways (kind room, direct, text or mail; network; chatRoomId, userId, number, fromNumber, address, url; blocked; reasonCode optedOut or notConnected), best (the first way, or null), blocked (a user the signed-in user blocked: no way)}. A person who is a user of this server shows only the numbers and addresses of the user's own rooms and rows, never the contacts' or the account's. roomPersonMap: chatRoomId to personKey.

Put people together for the signed-in user: one person with every address the persons named (personKeyList) show and the addresses given (addressKeyList: user:userId, tel:number, email:address, ext:chatExternalUserId; an address the user is shown in a person brings that person). Each must be one the user may name: a user they may reach, a number, a mail address, a bridge person of one of their own conversations. Changes only the user's own rows. A typed address is matched only against what the user is shown, and joins a user of this server only when already shown (notShown). reasonCode: badAddress, userNotFound, notYourRoom, personNotFound, nothingToMerge, twoUsers, notShown, contactsUnavailable (the contacts could not be asked now), tooManyAddresses (20 a person), tooManyPeople (2,000 rows a user).

Take an address (addressKey) out of its person for the signed-in user: it becomes a person of its own, which the app's contacts do not join back. reasonCode: badAddress, personNotFound, tooManyPeople.

The signed-in user's own name for a person (displayName, at most 100 characters; empty clears it). A person grouped automatically keeps its addresses as they are now (refused while the contacts cannot be asked: contactsUnavailable). reasonCode: personNotFound, tooManyPeople.
Undo the signed-in user's changes to a person (personKey p:id): its rows go, and its addresses are grouped automatically again. reasonCode personNotFound.

Internal: the contacts hook of chat's people. The framework keeps no contacts (they are the app's, such as Mantle's parties), so it asks the service the chat_contact_service property names, else the theme value STRT_CHAT_CONTACT_SERVICE of the user's qapps theme. The hook is called with authorization disabled, in a transaction of its own, with userId and addressList (tel:+E.164, email:address, user:userId; at most 300) and answers contactList: the contacts the user can see that have one of the addresses, each {contactRef, name, url (a path on this server), addressList (its own tel:, email: and user: addresses)}. It enforces the app's visibility itself. Kept: valid keys, at most 100 contacts and 10 addresses each. contactList is null when no hook is configured; a hook that fails or answers no list is logged once by name, hookFailed is true and the list is empty. The current user's; another user's only with authorization disabled.
